description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling WebSocket messages, including sending, receiving, and threading-based message management, as well as exception handling for WebSocket streams.

classes.name: MessageReceiver
classes.description: Threaded class for receiving WebSocket messages, supporting blocking, non-blocking, and callback methods.

classes.name: MessageSender
classes.description: Threaded class for sending WebSocket messages, supporting synchronous and asynchronous methods.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket message or fragment.

methods.name: receive_message
methods.description: Receives a WebSocket message or frame.
